reader_summary.overview: Andy spun out of Lone Star in 2017 to focus on the niche opportunity to invest in Tax Receivable Agreements or TRAs. Our conversation covers Andy's background and path to the hidden gem of TRAs. We cover the basics of a TRA, rationale for their use, drivers of return, and risks.

key_points.text: We then discuss Parallaxes' investment process, team, the future of the organization.
